title: Basic load combinations.
officialText:
Where strength design or load and resistance factor design is used, structures and portions
thereof shall resist the most critical effects from the following combinations of factored loads:
1.4D + F (Equation 16-1)
1.2(D + F + T) + 1.6(L + H) + 0.5(L or S or R) (Equation 16-2)
r
1.2D + 1.6(L or S or R) + (f L or 0.8W) (Equation 16-3)
r 1
1.2D + 1.6W + f L+ 0.5(L or S or R) (Equation 16-4)
1 r
1.2D + 1.0E + f L + f S (Equation 16-5)
1 2
0.9D + 1.6W + 1.6H (Equation 16-6)
0.9D + 1.0E + 1.6H (Equation 16-7)
where:
f = 1.0 for floors in places of public assembly, for live loads in excess of 100 pounds per square foot (4.79 kN/m2), and for
1
parking garage live load, and
= 0.5 for other live loads.
f = 0.7 for roof configurations (such as saw tooth) that do not shed snow off the structure, and
2
= 0.2 for other roof configurations.
Exception: Where other factored load combinations are specifically required by the provisions of this code, such
combinations shall take precedence.
